playlist.title: Playlist
playlist.description: A fully converted or created Spotify-to-YouTube playlist ready for user consumption or queue export.

id.description: The unique playlist ID, matching the Spotify code or a uniquely generated uuid.

description.description: The custom description of the playlist.

userId.description: The owner's Firebase authorization uid, used to scope access.

tracks.description: The array of fully matched tracks with video metadata.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp indicating when this playlist structure was last serialized or edited.

/playlists/{playlistId}.description: Collection of playlists synced to users' accounts.
